top_signals.title: China’s Huachen Energy Seeks Another Six-Year Extension on Bonds
top_signals.summary: Huachen Energy Co. is looking to push back the maturity of its outstanding bonds by another six years, according to people familiar with the matter, as an earlier extension deal is set to expire in December.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Anthropic researcher says AI has more than 10% chance of 'killing all humans' after colleague quits
top_signals.summary: An Anthropic safety researcher said there is a greater than 10% chance AI could "kill all humans" after a former colleague quits over safety concerns.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
